candidate_cap.enforcement: refuse to dispatch any structure/candidate beyond the frozen cap

reaction.reaction_scope_note: reaction_scope is net_reaction because reaction contract v1 has no field for TS/IRC evidence and therefore cannot substantiate an elementary-step claim. The candidate is intended as one elementary (concerted) step; that claim stays unasserted until the later P2 todos deliver TS/frequency/bidirectional-IRC evidence.

resource_budget.h4_open_consequence: No representative step timings exist, so the wall-clock ceilings are constructed and not derived from a measured chain budget. H4 remains OPEN until representative step timings are recorded and the full-chain budget is derived from them before a real run.

run_key_gap: B01 has not published acceptance-result.schema.json / acp2.acceptance.v1 or the (owner, scenario, phase, run_id) registry, so no run key is issued for this fixture and the real Diels-Alder run stays NOT_VERIFIED.

export_window_rule.rule: A reserved export window of export_budget_seconds starts after the last step reaches a terminal state (or after stop confirmation) and is available only for evidence export; it never extends the science deadline and never dispatches new science.
export_window_rule.starts_after: last terminal step or confirmed stop

in_flight_stop_rule.rule: After a stop/cancel request is accepted, no new step or retry may be dispatched. The in-flight step is stopped with confirmation, and its partial artifacts are not accepted as scientific evidence.

queue_accounting.policy: Queue wait is part of total wall time: the clock starts at started_at, so waiting for a scheduler slot consumes science and aggregate budget. The export window is reserved after the last terminal step and is never consumed by queue wait.

run_spec.started_at_basis: shared frozen epoch for every deadline in this fixture; it is not a run timestamp because no real run is authorized

sampling_boundaries.candidate_path_source: constructed single candidate path declared by this fixture; not discovered by an automated search
explicit_boundaries: one input conformation per endpoint; no conformer search or sampling
one declared candidate path; no automated transition-state search
other paths may exist; their absence is not evidence
sampling_boundaries.starting_structure_source: constructed geometries in reactants.xyz and product.xyz; no experimental or computed structure

science_parameters.activation_energy_definition: Delta-E-double-dagger = E(TS) - [E(butadiene) + E(ethene)] using electronic energies from the frozen method/basis and electronic state. Delta-G-double-dagger (298.15 K, 1 bar) additionally uses the thermochemistry of the frozen frequency calculations. No tunneling correction is applied. Only the declared candidate path is compared; the value is not an experimental rate.

backend_selection.note: TaskRequest.backend stays null; cccp capability selection is deterministic.

science_parameters.method_definition: wB97X-D4 / def2-TZVP, gas phase, restricted closed-shell singlet. No implicit solvent and no dispersion correction beyond D4 as implied by wB97X-D4.

scope.intended_candidate_kind_note: Intent only. reaction_scope is net_reaction in contract v1; the elementary-step claim requires evidence this fixture does not contain.

source: Constructed static fixture. Every structure, budget value and tolerance is labelled constructed; no real calculation, transition state, energy or reference value exists.

tolerances.note: The first four values mirror the frozen A-11a validator constants. The two comparison ceilings are constructed and are not derived from measured data or a reference energy.
